answer_1.quote: Query-focused summarization (QFS) ... focuses on generating concise summaries in response to posed queries ... We used two query-focused datasets during our study: (1) The QMSum dataset ... (2) SQuALITY ...

answer_2.quote: We compare the performance of our proposed system with existing state-of-the-art summarization techniques on the QMSum and SQuALITY benchmarks, employing ROUGE and BERTSCORE evaluation metrics ...

answer_4.quote: We conducted human evaluations to assess the quality of the summaries generated by LTRSUM ... For each case, we provided two annotators with shuffled summaries ... we ask the annotators to score each case on a scale of 1 to 5 ... in terms of three qualitative metrics: Fluency, Relevance, Faithfulness.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators score each generated summary on a 1‑5 Likert scale for Fluency, Relevance, and Faithfulness.
